Product Features

  • 2 in 1 Functional Treadmill: To make sure you exercise daily, you can choose to use this treadmill at home, and its quiet motor guarantees perfect performance for running, jogging, or walking. The treadmill can also lie flat under your standing desk, giving you the best in office fitness during your work. This treadmill weighs only 22kg, making it much more portable than most office exercise equipment.
  • High-Quality Structure Composition: The treadmill uses the latest treadmill technology coupled with a stylish and simple design to optimize the running experience at home. The core comes from the latest environmentally friendly drive motor, which impresses with its compactness, silence and energy-saving properties. Its durability has been thoroughly tested to ensure the greatest possible durability throughout its life cycle.
  • Easy Storage - Foldable Design: With the ability to be folded to just 12cm in height, the treadmill is easy to store, which is great for small spaces. Thanks to the simple folding technology, the folded dimensions are only 130.5 * 58 * 12 cm, with the device being raised to a height of 102 cm.
  • Powerful Motor & LED Display: Mechanically, the 1.0hp powerful and low-noise motor is specially designed for home use, so you don't have to worry about disturbing your family and neighbors. The LED display clearly shows time, speed, distance, and calories to monitor your progress in real-time. With speeds of up to 6 km/h, the machine is designed for daily fitness training.
  • Smart Control and Bluetooth: The treadmill has a Bluetooth speaker that you can connect to your phone to play music or podcasts while running or walking on the treadmill. By placing your phone on the stand and talking to your friends or watching your favorite show while exercising on this treadmill, you can eliminate the boredom of working out.
